<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Decode level 4 target pattern
# Center pieces:
# (2,1) center O: g-W-g / g-O-g / g-W-g → b-O-b / b-C-b / b-O-b
# (2,3) center b: g-W-g / g-b-g / g-g-W → b-O-b / b-C-b / b-b-O
# (4,2) center O: W-g-g / g-O-g / W-W-W → O-b-b / b-C-b / O-O-O
# Rule: W→O (click), g→b (don't click)

target_O = [
    (1,1), (1,3),
    (3,1), (3,4),
    (5,1), (5,2), (5,3)
]

# Verify overlaps
print("Target cells (should be orange):")
for r, c in sorted(target_O):
    print(f"  ({r},{c})")

# Compute pixel coords
# Row 1 starts at pixel 14, each row +8
# Col 0 starts at pixel 12, each col +8
# Cell center = start + 3
actions = []
for r, c in sorted(target_O):
    pixel_r = 14 + (r-1)*8 + 3
    pixel_c = 12 + c*8 + 3
    actions.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': pixel_r, 'col': pixel_c})
    print(f"  ({r},{c}) -> ({pixel_r},{pixel_c})")

print(f"\nClicking {len(actions)} cells...")
action(actions)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Decode level 4 target pattern
# Center pieces:
# (2,1) center O: g-W-g / g-O-g / g-W-g → b-O-b / b-C-b / b-O-b
# (2,3) center b: g-W-g / g-b-g / g-g-W → b-O-b / b-C-b / b-b-O
# (4,2) center O: W-g-g / g-O-g / W-W-W → O-b-b / b-C-b / O-O-O
# Rule: W→O (click), g→b (don't click)

target_O = [
    (1,1), (1,3),
    (3,1), (3,4),
    (5,1), (5,2), (5,3)
]

# Verify overlaps
print("Target cells (should be orange):")
for r, c in sorted(target_O):
    print(f"  ({r},{c})")

# Compute pixel coords
# Row 1 starts at pixel 14, each row +8
# Col 0 starts at pixel 12, each col +8
# Cell center = start + 3
actions = []
for r, c in sorted(target_O):
    pixel_r = 14 + (r-1)*8 + 3
    pixel_c = 12 + c*8 + 3
    actions.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': pixel_r, 'col': pixel_c})
    print(f"  ({r},{c}) -> ({pixel_r},{pixel_c})")

print(f"\nClicking {len(actions)} cells...")
action(actions)
